title: profiles.social_graph
description: Payload for the profiles.social_graph comm Function — one person's graph as a read-time feed needs it. Returns {"following": [user_id, ...], "blocked": [user_id, ...], "truncated": bool}. `following` is whom the user follows, newest follow first, minus anyone in `blocked`, cut at min(limit, PROFILES_FOLLOWING_MAX, default 5000) with truncated=true when cut. `blocked` is every id with a block between it and the user IN EITHER DIRECTION, as one undirected list that names no blocker, and is never cut. An id that cannot name a user RAISES, so the caller answers 503 rather than an empty graph.
